name: Spacecraft
source: Trajectories: JPL Horizons (https://ssd.jpl.nasa.gov/horizons/), geometric state vectors in ICRF/J2000. Models: NASA 3D Resources (https://github.com/nasa/NASA-3D-Resources), NASA 3D Resources (public domain; see NASA media usage guidelines). Landing sites from the published mission coordinates, planetocentric. Generated by tools/cosmodata/build_spacecraft.py — do not hand-edit.

orbit.source: JPL Horizons osculating elements for NAIF -125544 at 2026-07-31 TDB, ICRF/J2000, centre 500@399

orbit.model.source: two-body propagation of elements osculating at one epoch. The real orbit precesses: node -4.934 deg/day, apsides +3.645 deg/day under earth's J2.
